findings.claim: The compiled CLI generates a survey that its own list command cannot load from an external working directory.
findings.evidence: dist/survey new demo generates surveys/demo.ts with an @crafter/survey-cli/define import, then dist/survey list fails with Cannot find module '@crafter/survey-cli/define'. The source-package CLI path lists the same file successfully.

findings.claim: The new public command is absent from README and from the CLI registration regression test.
findings.evidence: README has no survey new usage and test/cli.test.ts does not assert that the new command is registered.
findings.layer: public command surface and regression coverage

exemptions.claim: The generated package import is valid when the CLI runs from the source package path.
exemptions.evidence: bun bin/survey.ts list discovered the generated demo survey from the same external directory. This does not refute the compiled-artifact failure.
